subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: BOUNDARY REFINEMENT of claim.law.MV_callee-saved-numbering-has-a-width-class-ahead-of-declaration-order.20260902.v1, and a COST the width class carries that the law does not state. MV is right that MWCC groups NARROW/byte-typed locals as their own class ahead of every word-sized local, and that reordering WITHIN a class moves a web while a cross-class reorder is byte-identical. The tempting corollary -- that RETYPING a local is therefore a cheap way to move it between classes when reordering has failed -- is FALSE for a specific and very common local shape, and that shape is the one a stuck recolor keeps producing: a local ASSIGNED FROM A WIDER CALL and thereafter only COMPARED. MEASURED on game/enemy/critter::CritterCollideItems at 84f85a96a, which four earlier probes had left as a pure 33-word REGFIELD-ONLY recolor with a 9-live-range callee-saved permutation, and whose own attempt record named the width class as the last untried source lever. `s32 type;` -> `s16 type;`, nothing else changed. `type` is assigned from `fn_8005D5C8(c, item)`, which returns s32, and is then tested against 0, 2 and 3. The narrowing does not relabel a web: it inserts a TRUNCATION at the definition and a RE-EXTENSION at the first test. probe.py: `target 148 insns, ours 149`, `net count: OURS is longer by 1`, `opcode multiset: DIFFERS target-only: +1 mr. ours-only: -1 extsh -1 extsh.`, `replace T[37:38]@94-98=['mr.'] O[37:39]@94-9c=['extsh', 'extsh.']`, with regnorm naming the two genuine structural rows `@0x94 T 'mr. r31,r3' / O 'extsh r30,r3'` and `@0x98 T 'beq <fn+0x224>' / O 'extsh. r0,r30'`. THE CONSEQUENCE IS DISPOSITIVE, NOT MERELY EXPENSIVE, AND THAT IS THE POINT: instruction-count parity is the precondition of EVERY postprocessor class (claim.law.webfrank-cannot-close-a-count-asymmetric-residual.20260831.v1), so on a function whose only remaining route is a recolor, entering the narrow width class and finishing through the postprocessor are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE BY CONSTRUCTION. The probe cannot even be arbitrated on fuzzy -- probe.py returned `CONFLICT-UNARBITRATED real 66 -> 65 IMPROVED but multiset 0t -> 3t vs best DIVERGED`, and the count alone settles it without the arbiter, because the function has left the class whatever fuzzy says. SCOPE, stated narrowly on purpose: this is about a local whose VALUE ARRIVES WIDE (from a call, or any expression MWCC types wider than the declaration) and whose uses are COMPARISONS rather than stores. A local genuinely holding a narrow value from a narrow source, or one whose uses are narrow stores, pays no such toll and MV's class is reachable for it. PRACTICAL RULE: before spending a build on a width retype as a recolor lever, read where the value comes FROM. If the source is wider than the proposed declaration, the retype is refuted before compiling -- the extension words are forced by the ABI of the assignment, not chosen by the allocator -- and the axis should be recorded dead rather than probed. This closed the last open source axis on CritterCollideItems and is why its recolor rule shipped.
